cv.name: Rodrigo Barragán
cv.headline: Senior Supply Chain Analyst | Electronics Manufacturing | S&OP
cv.summary: Industrial engineer with eleven years across agro-export, freelance logistics consulting and electronics manufacturing. I move between planning, inventory and import/export roles and bring a hands-on view of the whole chain.

experience.title: Senior Supply Chain Analyst
bullets: Run the monthly S&OP data pack for three customer programs
Built a safety-stock model in Python and Excel that cut excess inventory by USD 1.2M
Coordinate with buyers and production planning on component shortages
Maintain MRP parameters in SAP for 4,000+ part numbers

experience.title: Demand Planner
bullets: Forecasted demand for a telecom customer using statistical models in Kinaxis
Improved forecast accuracy from 68% to 79% over four quarters

experience.title: Logistics Consultant (freelance)
bullets: Set up warehouse processes and IMMEX compliance for two small exporters

experience.title: Import/Export Coordinator, previously Inventory Analyst
bullets: Managed berry export documentation to the US and customs brokers
Ran cycle counts and inventory reconciliation
